title: How a Neuron Fires - The Action Potential
description:
A neuron at rest holds a negative electrical charge inside its membrane.

When a signal arrives, sodium channels snap open, flooding the cell with positive ions. This electrical spike races down the axon, leaping between myelin gaps. At the synapse, it triggers neurotransmitter release to fire the next neuron.
